name: Protect Thy Neighbor (Prayer)
body:
The gods of protection aid you in your protection of another.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Protection Domain

Benefit: When you aid another to grant a bonus to another’s armor class, the bonus increases to +4 for a single round per day.
